queries: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, 1.0 * SUM(spent) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), relative_ratios AS (SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM event_ratios), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, relative_ratio FROM relative_ratios ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
